```{r, include = FALSE}
# Show chunks with a `fold` option as collapsible sections with that title
knitr::knit_hooks$set(fold = function(before, options) {
  if (before) {
    paste0("\n\n<details><summary>", options$fold, "</summary>\n\n")
  } else {
    "\n\n</details>\n\n"
  }
})
```
